rationale: US Treasury yields at 19-year peak continue to tighten domestic financial conditions; Pentagon confirms munitions shortfalls from Iran war affecting military readiness; Hormuz tanker attack threatens oil supply.

top_events.title: US Treasury yields hit 19-year peak
top_events.label: US Treasury yields reach 19-year high
top_events.summary: 10-year Treasury yield hits 5.02%, tightening financial conditions and raising borrowing costs for Americans.

top_events.title: Iran war has led to US munitions shortfalls, Pentagon inspector confirms
top_events.label: Pentagon confirms munitions shortfalls from Iran war
top_events.summary: Inspector confirms US munitions shortfalls and resupply bottlenecks from Iran conflict, affecting military readiness.

top_events.title: Two sailors missing after tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz, Oman says
top_events.label: Tanker attacked in Hormuz sailors missing
top_events.summary: Oil tanker struck by missile and drone in Strait of Hormuz with crew missing, threatening US energy supply.

most_significant_event.label: US bond yields hit 19-year high
most_significant_event.summary: 10-year Treasury yield reaches 5.02%, highest since 2007 financial crisis, as oil prices surge. Tightens financial conditions; affects mortgage rates, business borrowing, and household costs.
most_significant_event.title: Benchmark US government bond yield hits 19-year peak as oil prices surge
